# EventBridge Pipes

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/pipes@v1.26.4` · last audited 2026-10-10 (`302aa4e3c`)

### Known gaps

- Timestream target (TimestreamParameters) is accepted and persisted but delivery returns ErrUnsupportedPipeTarget; services/timestreamwrite exists, so a WriteRecords adapter is the missing piece.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- MSK, self-managed Kafka, RabbitMQ and ActiveMQ pipe sources are modeled in the wire shapes but never polled: services/kafka and services/mq are control-plane only, and no in-process Kafka/AMQP/OpenWire broker exists to read from.
